subject: LLM bug-review precision per context layer, confidence threshold, cost per finding

corpus.ground_truth: S2b authored probe corpus (21 vulnerable, 4 safe)
corpus.attribution_method: finding line range must cover the truth pattern's vulnerable line; file+line exact, no ±6 nearest-match heuristic

L1.context: finding only: rule id, message, severity, flagged lines
L1.corpus_recall_note: LLM precision is over the 10 findings Semgrep surfaced from 21 positives; the 21-pattern corpus recall belongs to S2b, not here.

cost.tokens: unavailable on the opencode CLI transport (chars reported instead)

L2.context: finding plus smallest S1 syntax-aware chunk containing it
L2.corpus_recall_note: LLM precision is over the 10 findings Semgrep surfaced from 21 positives; the 21-pattern corpus recall belongs to S2b, not here.

cost.tokens: unavailable on the opencode CLI transport (chars reported instead)

cost_summary.note: opencode CLI transport: no token usage; cost = calls + chars + wall seconds

verdict.note: These are OUR 21 authored patterns, not a third-party benchmark. The finding-level precision measures the judge's ability to confirm or reject Semgrep findings, not Semgrep's or Sentra's corpus recall. Safe-control false positives cannot be measured above zero on this run because Semgrep raised no finding on any of the 4 controls.
verdict.confidence_caveat: Threshold precision/recall is on 10 findings per layer; one verdict moves precision by 0.1. Treat the sweep as directional, not stable.
